params.body:
Closes #1054

## Why

Whoever makes something in the platform's look outside the app (a tutorial, a slide, print) needs two things: the name of the typeface and the colour codes. The app had both, but you could not find or use them:

- `/huisstijl` showed the text roles in Inter but never wrote the word "Inter".
- A colour swatch showed its token name (`--brand-blue`). The brand colours had no note at all, and the hex code that a design or video tool asks for was only in a comment in `resources/css/colour.css`.
- Nothing in the app linked to `/huisstijl`.

## What changes

- **`/huisstijl` opens with "For a tutorial, a slide or print"** (`#brand`). It names the typeface, shows the three weights (400, 500, 600) with their use, and says where to get it. It also shows eleven colours with their hex code and what each is for: brand blue, deep blue, navy, the top bar, ink, quiet ink, the page ground, the card surface, and the three state colours.
- **Every solid swatch further down the page shows its hex code too.** A line has none, because it carries an opacity.
- **Values are still read from the stylesheets.** `DesignTokens::hex()` turns a resolved token (`rgb(10 143 212)`, `#fff`) into `#0a8fd4` / `#ffffff`, or returns null for something that is not a solid colour. `DesignTokens::typeface()` reads the first family of `--ui-font` and drops the `Variable` suffix of the self-hosted cut.
- **Documentatie & support has a link "Huisstijl: lettertype en kleuren"** to `/huisstijl#brand`, for administrators only. The page is written in English for whoever builds, so a dealer's list of manuals stays as it was. Anyone logged in can still open the URL (R P2-4.6).
- **New business rule R P1-1.30.**

No stylesheet, token or Tailwind class changes, so `public/build` stays the same.

## Checked

- `TheTypefaceAndColoursCarryTheirCodesTest` (new) checks four things. Every colour built from a `-rgb` token reads as the hex code in that token's comment in `colour.css`. The typeface is named "Inter". The page opens with the typeface and its weights, before the text roles, and has eleven swatches whose labels match `DesignTokens::hex`. Documentatie links the page for an administrator and not for an ordinary user.
- Also run: `TextRolesTest`, `TypographyTest`, `TheNeutralsLiveInOnePlaceTest`, `TheShapeIsQuietTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`, `DelegationTest`, `PlatformStaffAreNotAGarageTest`. Full suite: 3174 tests, no failures. PHPStan: no errors. `bin/rules-sources` finds no problems.
- Rendered locally as an administrator at 1280 px and 390 px wide. The swatches fall into one column on a phone.

Source: Portal mail:35.
params.title: Show the typeface and the colour codes on /huisstijl, link it from Documentatie
